_meta.requires: patch_index_kind_government.py must be applied to index.html first, or these entries fail activeKinds.has() and vanish
_meta.target: entries at any depth, matched on country + url
_meta.method: name-based and deliberately conservative. The entry name must lead with a public-body word (ministry, supreme audit, statistical office, company/land registry, procurement portal, court, tribunal, agency, authority, commission, directorate, inspectorate, ombudsman) within its first 45 characters, must not carry an NGO or IGO marker, and must not read as a statute, procedure or how-to entry.
_meta.not_used: kind=='institution' AND voice=='official' (4,227 rows) was tested as a blanket rule and REJECTED: sampling returned GEF small grants, COICA, a farmers' confederation and a university centre alongside the ministries. The pairing does not mean government body.
_meta.trust: government maps to high in KIND2TIER, the same as structured and institution, so no entry changes trust tier
